newsitem.title: USA: Albemarle plans to build production plant.
newsitem.headline: Albemarle plans to build production plant.

text.p: Albemarle Corp said Wednesday it plans to build a production facility for its Saytex RB-100 flame retardant that is expected to start up in late 1998 or early 1999.
The plant project is to be presented to its board of directors later this year, it said.
Albemarle said it plans to finalize the plant's design and production capacity this summer and break ground for the facility in autumn.
Saytex RB-100 flame retardant is used in epoxies, phenolics, polystyrene, polycarbonates, and unsaturated polyesters.
